name: Jimi
source:
Jitan's youngest son, and the younger brother of Jean and Jou. He currently studying at a high school on the mainland. His stature makes him a star player on the American Football team.

However unlike his cousin Shigeru he isn't that popular with girls. He wants to find a whore like his sister in laws to introduce to the family.
